gate_freeze.timing: bound in candidate_pack and composed_prompt_audit before the single image call
gate_freeze.same_image_policy: all profile gates must pass simultaneously in render-attempt-01.png

profile_hard_gates.criterion: The descending traveler remains visibly alive and agentive.
Human-world origin cues remain visible behind the traveler.
A bounded crossing establishes a clear downward direction.
A distinct underworld realm lies beyond the crossed boundary.
A purpose token or mission cue accompanies the living visitor.

supplemental_pixel_checks.criterion: The living actor, downward and astrolabe action, ferryman/map-tablet target, and broken-chain consequence are simultaneously legible.
The generated adult subject retains the reference's observable face-and-hair cues without making a same-person claim.
Hands, feet, astrolabe grip, skeletal reach, chain interaction, and ground contact are grossly coherent.
No distracting pseudo-lettering or malformed text appears when readable text was not requested.

qualification_rule.qualified: every profile_hard_gate is pass in the same saved image
qualification_rule.revise: one or more profile_hard_gates fail or are only partial
qualification_rule.unscored: no saved pixels are available for direct review
qualification_rule.user_preference: pending until provided directly by the requesting user
